title: the semantic tier counts hits it cannot return when no embedder is configured
body:
`intent search "how are old backups removed" --tier semantic --limit 5 --json` on the live tree at e70c3528a answers `{"matched":6,"returned":5,"groups":[]}`; the prose form prints only `note: 5 of 6 shown -- raise --limit for the rest` and no rows. No embedder is configured for this project (`intent/.config/config.json` carries no search, index or embedder key; `intentsvcs/src/embed.rs:93` is the embedder for a project with none configured). So the semantic tier counts hits it cannot return. An LLM reading `matched: 6` believes six semantic hits exist and were withheld. A tier with no embedder should say so in the answer (its own row in `index`, or a group carrying the reason) and count nothing.

CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): a semantic tier asked for by name that cannot answer now says so. `SearchAnswer` carries `unanswered: [{tier, reason}]` (serialised only when present), the terminal prints `note: the semantic tier did not answer -- no embedder is configured for this project`, and nothing is counted. The counted-but-dropped rows were 0357's cause, fixed with it. Before: `matched 6, returned 5, groups []`. After: `matched 0, returned 0`, the reason carried.
